title: Unchecked ERC4626 deposit return value in BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch
description: IERC4626(sUSDS).deposit return value is ignored at BalancerPoolerV2.sol:183. Bounded because subsequent logic does not rely on it: pool() re-reads balanceOf(address(this)) (line 192) rather than the deposit return, so accounting uses the actual held sUSDS.
impact: None. Accounting uses actual held sUSDS via balanceOf re-read.
attackPath: IERC4626(sUSDS).deposit return is ignored at line 183; bounded because subsequent logic does not rely on it.
recommendation: Capture and assert the ERC4626 deposit return value (shares minted) for accounting hygiene, even though the current balanceOf re-read makes the gap harmless.
justification: Accounting-hygiene hardening with bounded/no impact -> QA.
